role.roleTitle: Service Analytics Analyst, Lift and Escalator Maintenance

evidence.text: Designed the callout fact table and the equipment and site dimensions in SQL Server at Ardent Lift Services, loading the handheld callout logs every night.

Analysed repeat callouts on hydraulic lifts and, with the technical support engineers, introduced a door-operator inspection step. Repeat callouts within 30 days on the south branch went from 11.8% of callouts in July to December 2022 to 7.1% in July to December 2023.
Published the monthly contract performance report (response times, first-time fix rate, open faults) for eleven key accounts and the four branch managers.
Each quarter, listed lifts by fault frequency so that the planners could book preventive visits for the most fault-prone units first.
evidence.notes: The candidate listed lifts by fault frequency, but it is not clear if this directly supports the planning of preventive maintenance visits.
